params.prompt:
Create a production 2D game character asset atlas for STARBIT – Kingdom of Dreams. Match the actual supplied game art references closely: rounded child-friendly storybook characters, large expressive jewel-like eyes, chunky readable forms, clean dark indigo outlines, hand-painted/cel shaded soft volume, polished colorful cartoon rendering. The first reference is the existing enchanted bear Brucoun, the second is the hero Bit (STYLE ONLY, do not draw Bit), the third is the existing purple Stinko. Preserve this art family's brushwork, outlines, highlights and proportions. NO photorealism, NO pixel art, NO rough sketch, NO horror, NO gore, no thin fiddly limbs. These are flat 2D sprite illustrations with soft painted volume, not 3D models.

MANDATORY ATLAS LAYOUT: exactly FOUR separate full-body character sprites in a perfectly regular 2 by 2 grid on a genuinely TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. One sprite entirely inside each equal square quadrant. Do not draw grid lines, labels, letters, numbers, titles, frames or scenery. No floors, no contact shadows. Keep at least 10 percent clear padding around every sprite inside its own quadrant; keep the central horizontal and vertical divider completely empty. Never overlap quadrants, never crop any anatomy or magical wisps. Each character should occupy approximately 75 percent of its own quadrant, centered horizontally with feet near the same baseline. All sprites use the same side-scroller camera: full-body three-quarter SIDE view facing RIGHT, body and head turned toward the right so movement direction is unmistakable, the near eye and a little of the far eye visible, no front-on lineup poses. Preserve recognizable silhouette at small gameplay scale. One readable neutral/ready pose per character, not multiple animation frames. Purple curse magic is restrained, neatly contained near the body.

SET A / FOREST, VILLAGE, SKY. Top LEFT: STINKO, preserve the supplied purple little shadow-cat spirit's identity, plump dark plum body, two tiny pointed ears, enormous mint-green eyes, luminous lilac star on chest, short legs, curled smoky lilac tail, mischievous wary expression. Top RIGHT: KORENOVY SKOKAN, a brand-new squat enchanted tree-stump hopper, warm cut-wood barrel body with expressive eyes in bark, moss hair, tiny branch arms and TWO thick bent springlike root legs, a small violet curse knot on brow, clear hopping-ready silhouette. Bottom LEFT: LAMPOVNIK, an enchanted walking village lantern, squat rounded aged brass and walnut frame, arched handle, glass belly containing a little violet flame with two curious mint eyes, two sturdy short wooden feet and tiny hinged arms, warm ochre palette with purple curse accents. Bottom RIGHT: MRAKOMOR, a compact sentient storm cloud, fluffy blue-lavender lobes, two large teal eyes and grumpy heavy purple eyebrows, a single curled dark cloud tail, three small suspended rounded raindrops close beneath its body, no legs, hovering side view. Distinct silhouettes: cat, stump, lantern, cloud.
